name: Blue Dream
description: A legendary sativa-dominant hybrid known for full-body relaxation with gentle cerebral invigoration.

name: OG Kush
description: The backbone of West Coast cannabis varieties. Delivers heavy euphoria mixed with strong body relaxation.

name: Girl Scout Cookies
description: A potent hybrid with OG Kush and Durban Poison lineage. Known for full-body relaxation and cerebral euphoria.

name: Sour Diesel
description: A fast-acting sativa named for its pungent fuel-like aroma. Delivers dreamy cerebral effects.

name: Granddaddy Purple
description: A famous indica cross of Purple Urkle and Big Bud. Known for complex grape and berry aroma and deep body relaxation.

name: Jack Herer
description: Named after the cannabis activist. A sativa-dominant strain known for its clear-headed, creative buzz.

name: Gelato
description: A sweet, dessert-like hybrid from Cookie Fam Genetics. Delivers powerful yet balanced effects.

name: Northern Lights
description: One of the most famous indicas of all time. Produces dreamy euphoria and deep body relaxation.

name: White Widow
description: A balanced hybrid first bred in the Netherlands. Known for its white crystal resin buds and burst of energy.

name: Wedding Cake
description: Also known as Pink Cookies. A rich, tangy hybrid with relaxing and euphoric effects.

name: Gorilla Glue #4
description: A potent hybrid known for its heavy-handed euphoria and relaxation. Glues you to the couch.

name: Pineapple Express
description: A sativa-dominant hybrid combining Trainwreck and Hawaiian. Delivers long-lasting energetic buzz.

name: Purple Haze
description: A classic sativa that delivers dreamy, blissful euphoria and creative stimulation. Inspired by Jimi Hendrix.

name: Bubba Kush
description: A heavy indica known for its tranquilizing effects. Perfect for a slow, comfortable evening.

name: Green Crack
description: A sharp energy and focus provider. Great for daytime use with a tangy, fruity flavor.

name: AK-47
description: Despite its aggressive name, this sativa-dominant hybrid delivers a steady, long-lasting mellow buzz.

name: Strawberry Cough
description: Known for its sweet strawberry smell and potent sativa effects. Great for managing social anxiety.

name: Zkittlez
description: An award-winning indica with a fruity candy-like flavor profile. Delivers calming and happy effects.

name: Runtz
description: A rare evenly balanced hybrid of Zkittlez and Gelato. Known for its incredibly fruity flavor and long-lasting high.

name: Mimosa
description: A sativa-leaning hybrid known for its rising cerebral effects and energizing buzz. Great morning strain.

name: Do-Si-Dos
description: A potent indica cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Face Off OG. Heavy-hitting relaxation.

name: MAC (Miracle Alien Cookies)
description: A balanced, creamy hybrid cross of Alien Cookies x Starfighter x Columbian. Complex flavor and uplifting effects.

name: Trainwreck
description: A potent sativa-dominant hybrid with sharp mind-bending effects. Hits hard and fast like a freight train.

name: Skywalker OG
description: A heavy indica cross of Skywalker and OG Kush. Delivers powerful full-body relaxation and lazy euphoria.

name: Durban Poison
description: A pure South African sativa. Known for its sweet smell and energetic, uplifting effects.

name: Lemon Haze
description: A sativa-dominant cross of Lemon Skunk and Silver Haze with a zesty lemon smell and taste.

name: Cherry Pie
description: A hybrid of Granddaddy Purple and Durban Poison. Known for its sweet and sour cherry pie aroma.

name: Purple Punch
description: A sedating cross of Larry OG and Granddaddy Purple. Hits you with grape candy and blueberry muffins one-two punch.

name: Cereal Milk
description: A rare evenly balanced hybrid known for its sweet creamy flavor reminiscent of the milk left after cereal.

name: Ice Cream Cake
description: A heavy indica cross of Wedding Cake and Gelato #33. Sedating effects with delicious dessert flavors.

name: Super Lemon Haze
description: A two-time Cannabis Cup winner. A kief-caked sativa with energetic, lively effects and a lemony aroma.

name: GSC Thin Mint
description: A Girl Scout Cookies phenotype with a mint chocolate finish. Balanced euphoria and body relaxation.

name: Banana Kush
description: A heavy indica with a smooth banana flavor. Creates mellow happiness and lazy tranquility.

name: Biscotti
description: A rare indica cross of Gelato #25 with Sour Florida OG. Cookie-like flavor with potent relaxation.

name: Sunset Sherbet
description: An indica-leaning hybrid descended from Girl Scout Cookies. Full-body relaxation with a clear-headed high.

name: Blue Cheese
description: A cross of Blueberry and UK Cheese. Known for its unique savory-sweet flavor and slow, relaxing effects.

name: Tangie
description: A sativa remake of the 1995 Tangerine Dream. Delivers citrusy creative euphoria.

name: Amnesia Haze
description: A powerful sativa with Jamaican and South Asian landrace genetics. Intense cerebral buzz.

name: Wedding Crasher
description: A sociable hybrid of Wedding Cake and Purple Punch. Great for conversations and gatherings.

name: Maui Wowie
description: A classic Hawaiian sativa. Light stress-relieving effects and tropical flavors transport you to the islands.

name: King Louis XIII
description: A heavy OG Kush phenotype named after the French king. Royally potent sedation.

name: Forbidden Fruit
description: A cross of Cherry Pie and Tangie. Exotic fruit flavors with deeply relaxing physical effects.

name: Platinum OG
description: A heavy-hitting indica descended from OG Kush and Purps. Known for its intense physical effects.

name: Headband
description: Named for the slight pressure around the crown of your head. A cross of OG Kush and Sour Diesel.

name: Larry OG
description: An OG Kush phenotype with balanced effects. Clear-headed and good for daytime use.

name: Candy Kush
description: A sweet-tasting hybrid with gentle, comfortable effects. Like candy for your mind and body.

name: Critical Mass
description: A heavy indica known for massive buds and deeply relaxing effects. Great for pain and insomnia.

name: LA Confidential
description: An award-winning pure indica from Los Angeles. Smooth, fast-acting sedation and psychedelic effects.

name: Super Silver Haze
description: A three-time Cannabis Cup winner. Energetic and long-lasting body buzz with creative stimulation.

name: Bruce Banner #3
description: Named after the Hulk's alter ego. One of the strongest strains available with a creative, euphoric rush.

name: Apple Fritter
description: A potent hybrid from Sour Apple and Animal Cookies. Delivers heavy relaxation with a cheesy apple pastry flavor.

name: London Pound Cake
description: A heavy Cookies Fam indica with a nutty, berry flavor. Known for potent body sedation.

name: Gary Payton
description: Named after the NBA legend. A complex hybrid with euphoric and talkative effects.

name: Jealousy
description: A gelato x Sherbet cross bred by Seed Junky Genetics. Balanced effects and complex flavors.

name: Slurricane
description: A potent indica cross of Do-Si-Dos and Purple Punch. Heavy syrupy sweetness with knockout relaxation.

name: Lava Cake
description: A potent indica cross of Thin Mint GSC and Grape Pie. Rich, dessert-like flavors with deep sedation.

name: White Runtz
description: A rare phenotype of Runtz. Covered in trichomes with sweet candy flavors and potent balanced effects.

name: Dosidos
description: A cross of GSC and Face Off OG. Sedating effects with a sweet, earthy flavor.

name: Kush Mints
description: A cross of Animal Mints and Bubba Kush. Minty flavor with balanced, relaxing effects.

name: GMO Cookies
description: Also known as Garlic Cookies. A potent indica with unique garlic, mushroom, and onion flavors.

name: Gorilla Cookies
description: A cross of GG4 and Thin Mint GSC. Potent hybrid with dessert flavors and balanced effects.

name: MAC 1
description: A cap cut of the original MAC strain. Known for rare, exotic effects and creative stimulation.

name: Tropicana Cookies
description: A sativa-dominant cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Tangie. Bright citrus flavor with uplifting energy.

name: Orange Cookies
description: A cross of Orange Juice and GSC. Sweet orange flavor with balanced, happy effects.

name: Mango Kush
description: A delicious indica with genuine mango taste and banana undertones. Gentle, fuzzy euphoria.

name: Peanut Butter Breath
description: A cross of Do-Si-Dos and Mendo Breath. Unique nutty, herbal flavor with sedating effects.

name: Strawberry Banana
description: A 70/30 indica-dominant hybrid with incredible fruity flavor. Peaceful and happy effects.

name: Tahoe OG
description: A heavy OG Kush phenotype bred near Lake Tahoe. One of the most sedating OGs available.

name: Grape Ape
description: A predominantly indica strain with a distinct grape-like smell. Provides carefree relaxation.

name: Alien OG
description: A cross of Tahoe OG and Alien Kush. Initially cerebral before transitioning to heavy-body relaxation.

name: Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: A rare hybrid of Sunset Sherbert and GSC. Dessert-like flavor with mood-lifting, creative effects.

name: ZaZa
description: A potent exotic indica. Known for premium quality and deeply relaxing, sedative effects.

name: Cherry Gelato
description: A delicious cross of GSC and Sunset Sherbet. Fruity cherry flavor with balanced happy effects.

name: Papaya
description: A heavy indica with tropical papaya flavors. Strong sedation and munchies.

name: Motorbreath
description: A pungent, gassy indica cross of Chemdog and SFV OG Kush. Heavy diesel flavor with potent sedation.

name: Hawaiian
description: A classic tropical sativa. Light and breezy effects perfect for daytime adventures.

name: Laughing Buddha
description: A Cannabis Cup winning sativa. Named for its tendency to induce uncontrollable laughter and joy.

name: Khalifa Kush
description: Developed in collaboration with Wiz Khalifa. An OG Kush derivative with focused, creative effects.

name: Animal Cookies
description: A heavy indica cross of GSC and Fire OG. Strong sedation with a sweet, sour flavor.

name: Glue Gelato
description: A potent cross of GG4 and Gelato. Couch-locking relaxation with sweet flavors.

name: Obama Runtz
description: A rare hybrid cross of Afghani and Runtz. Sweet fruity flavor with giggly, social effects.

name: Pink Runtz
description: A phenotype of Runtz with pink-hued buds. Candy-sweet flavor with euphoric, social effects.

name: Gushers
description: A cross of Gelato #41 and Triangle Kush. Named after the candy for its fruity, gushing flavor.

name: Fire OG
description: Considered one of the strongest OG Kush strains. Powerful full-body relaxation and sedation.

name: Super Boof
description: A sativa-leaning hybrid of Black Cherry Punch and Tropicana Cookies. Creative energy with fruity flavor.

name: Gas Face
description: A potent hybrid known for its gassy terpene profile and balanced cerebral effects.

name: Limoncello
description: A bright sativa named after the Italian liqueur. Zesty lemon flavor with focused, clear-headed energy.

name: LA Kush Cake
description: A potent cross of Kush Mints and Wedding Cake. Dessert flavors with heavy body sedation.

name: Guava
description: An exotic sativa with tropical guava flavors. Social and energizing effects.

name: White Cherry Gelato
description: A cross of White Cherry and Gelato 33. Creamy cherry flavor with balanced hybrid effects.

name: Grease Monkey
description: A cross of GG4 and Cookies and Cream. Heavy relaxation with a sweet, vanilla-diesel flavor.

name: Member Berry
description: A balanced hybrid with sweet berry flavor. Provides clear-headed focus with gentle relaxation.

name: Black Cherry Punch
description: A cross of Black Cherry Pie and Purple Punch. Deep cherry flavor with heavy body sedation.

name: Dolato
description: A cross of Do-Si-Dos and Gelato #41. Deeply relaxing indica with complex berry and lavender notes.

name: Zookies
description: A hybrid cross of Animal Cookies and Gorilla Glue #4. Cookie-gas flavor with creative relaxation.

name: Champagne Cake
description: A celebratory hybrid with champagne-like effervescence. Bubbly, social effects.

name: Space Cake
description: A potent indica cross of GSC and Snow Lotus. Out-of-this-world relaxation with dessert flavors.

name: Fatso
description: A heavy indica cross of Legends OG and GMO. Potent sedation and intense munchies.

name: Pancakes
description: A Cookies Fam indica with a breakfast-inspired flavor. Heavy sedation and comfort food cravings.

name: Gelonade
description: A sativa-dominant cross of Lemon Tree and Gelato 41. Bright citrus flavor with clear-headed energy.

name: Grandpa Larry
description: A potent OG Kush descendant. Old-school indica relaxation that puts you right to sleep.

name: Georgia Pie
description: A Cookies Fam hybrid with genuine peach pie flavor. Balanced effects perfect for social settings.

name: Snow Cap
description: A potent sativa with frosty, trichome-covered buds. Delivers clean, focused energy and menthol freshness.
